record.paper_title: Research Problems on Relations Between Nijenhuis Geometry and Integrable Systems
record.original_question: For the commutative associative operations T_M induced by symmetries M of a gl-regular Nijenhuis operator L, prove in full generality, using only tensorial calculations, that the associated Ako–Yano bracket vanishes.

evidence.quote: (3) Prove the vanishing of the Ako-Yano bracket in general case, using only tensorial calculations.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L:TM\to TM$ be a Nijenhuis operator on a smooth manifold $M$, that is, a $(1,1)$-tensor field whose Nijenhuis torsion
$$
\mathcal{N}_L(X,Y) := L^2[X,Y] - L[LX,Y] - L[X,LY] + [LX,LY]
$$
vanishes for all vector fields $X,Y$. Assume $L$ is gl-regular, meaning that at every point the algebraic type of $L$ is such that its centralizer in $\mathrm{End}(TM)$ has the minimal possible dimension (equivalently, every eigenvalue of $L$ has geometric multiplicity one).

A symmetry of $L$ is a $(1,1)$-tensor field $M$ commuting with $L$ such that the "twisted" Nijenhuis-type expression
$$
[L,M]_{\mathrm{FN}}(X,Y) := L M[X,Y] - L[MX,Y] - L[X,MY] + [LMX,Y] + [MX,LY] - M[LX,Y]\ldots
$$
(the Frölicher–Nijenhuis bracket of $L$ and $M$) vanishes. To each such symmetry $M$ one associates a commutative associative product $T_M$ on a suitable algebra of functions/tensors built from $L$ and $M$ via the standard symmetry construction for gl-regular Nijenhuis operators.

The Ako–Yano bracket is the bilinear operation on the space of such commutative associative products $T_M$ defined by the natural concomitant of two $(1,2)$-tensors that measures the obstruction to their compatibility (the analogue, for symmetric products, of the Schouten–Nijenhuis bracket for Poisson structures).

Problem. Prove, by purely tensorial computation in arbitrary dimension and for arbitrary gl-regular $L$ and arbitrary symmetry $M$, that the Ako–Yano bracket of the products $T_M$ associated to symmetries of a gl-regular Nijenhuis operator vanishes identically.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open research problem in the program on Nijenhuis geometry and integrable systems. A web search returned related literature on gl-regular Nijenhuis operators and Schouten–Nijenhuis-type brackets, but no source establishing the vanishing of the Ako–Yano bracket for symmetry-induced products in full generality via tensorial calculations.

status_evidence.title: Nijenhuis Geometry III: gl-regular Nijenhuis operators
status_evidence.snippet: Study of gl-regular Nijenhuis operators and their symmetries, providing the framework in which the Ako–Yano bracket question is formulated.
status_evidence.claim: The framework of gl-regular Nijenhuis operators and their symmetries is developed but a general tensorial proof of the Ako–Yano bracket vanishing is not given there.

status_evidence.title: Applications of Nijenhuis Geometry V
status_evidence.snippet: Recent application paper in the Nijenhuis geometry program; does not contain a general tensorial proof of vanishing of the Ako–Yano bracket for symmetry-induced products.
status_evidence.claim: No proof of the desired tensorial identity appears in the recent applications papers found.
